cooling.effective_update_definition: Component parameter byte hash changed during that optimizer step.
cooling.gradient_scope: Combined actor/critic policy global L2 norm before gradient clipping.
cooling.statistics_scope: Statistics over reported episode metrics; means are not minibatch-weighted across episodes.

task.effective_update_definition: Component parameter byte hash changed during that optimizer step.
task.gradient_scope: Combined actor/critic policy global L2 norm before gradient clipping.
task.statistics_scope: Statistics over reported episode metrics; means are not minibatch-weighted across episodes.

task_actions.forced_wait_attribution: Deadline reservation guard; every other task mask permits start.
task_actions.unique_job_caveat: Missing unique deferred-job counts are reported as null, never zero. Unique voluntarily delayed jobs cannot be reconstructed from aggregate action or task-interval counts when unique job counts are absent, even if guard triggers are zero. If present, policy_deferred_tasks includes guard waits and is unique only within each episode.
task_actions.voluntarily_deferred_jobs_scope: Available only if unique deferred-job counts were persisted for every episode and every guard trigger count in this group is zero. Counts repeated task executions, unique within each episode, not across sampled scenes or augmentations.

all_train.waiting_jct_scope: Pooled means weight episode waiting by arrived tasks and completed JCT by completed tasks. Waiting includes all observed pending time, including capacity and policy/guard delays; JCT excludes unfinished jobs. Weights count repeated executions across sampled scenes, not unique original jobs.

analysis_scope: Post-run artifact analysis only; no policy rollout, training, test, scenario payload or heldout access.

task_actions.forced_wait_attribution: Deadline reservation guard; every other task mask permits start.
task_actions.unique_job_caveat: Missing unique deferred-job counts are reported as null, never zero. Unique voluntarily delayed jobs cannot be reconstructed from aggregate action or task-interval counts when unique job counts are absent, even if guard triggers are zero. If present, policy_deferred_tasks includes guard waits and is unique only within each episode.
task_actions.voluntarily_deferred_jobs_scope: Available only if unique deferred-job counts were persisted for every episode and every guard trigger count in this group is zero. Counts repeated task executions, unique within each episode, not across sampled scenes or augmentations.

early.waiting_jct_scope: Pooled means weight episode waiting by arrived tasks and completed JCT by completed tasks. Waiting includes all observed pending time, including capacity and policy/guard delays; JCT excludes unfinished jobs. Weights count repeated executions across sampled scenes, not unique original jobs.
